_comment: Models for the non-text engines. Sizes in bytes are the exact values published by the host (Hugging Face API / GitHub release headers); sha256 given where we verified a download ourselves.

speech_to_text.maker: OpenAI (Whisper weights, MIT) converted by ggml-org
speech_to_text.languages: 99 languages including English and Spanish (the .en variants are English-only and are not used)

models.plain_en: Tiny — fast on any device, makes mistakes with names and accents.
models.plain_es: Tiny — rápido en cualquier equipo, se equivoca con nombres y acentos.

models.plain_en: Base — good for dictation on a normal laptop.
models.plain_es: Base — bien para dictar en una notebook normal.

models.plain_en: Small — clearly better with accents and Spanish; needs a 4-core processor to keep up.
models.plain_es: Small — claramente mejor con acentos y castellano; necesita 4 núcleos para seguir el ritmo.

models.plain_en: Large v3 Turbo (compressed) — best quality; comfortable on 8+ cores or Apple Silicon.
models.plain_es: Large v3 Turbo (comprimido) — la mejor calidad; cómodo con 8+ núcleos o Apple Silicon.

text_to_speech.maker: hexgrad (Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0); ONNX export and voices by thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx
text_to_speech.plain_en: Kokoro — a small, natural-sounding voice that runs on the processor; English and Spanish voices.
text_to_speech.plain_es: Kokoro — una voz chica y natural que corre en el procesador; voces en inglés y castellano.

z-image-turbo.name: Z-Image-Turbo
z-image-turbo.license_source: model card of Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo (stated there; re-check before redistribution)
z-image-turbo.plain_en: Makes detailed 1024-pixel pictures from a description in 8 quick steps; good with text in images and realistic scenes.
z-image-turbo.plain_es: Crea imágenes detalladas de 1024 píxeles a partir de una descripción en 8 pasos rápidos; buena con texto en la imagen y escenas realistas.
z-image-turbo.limits_en: One style per model; no video; hands and small faces can come out wrong; prompts in English work best.
z-image-turbo.limits_es: Un estilo por modelo; sin video; manos y caras chicas pueden salir mal; los pedidos en inglés funcionan mejor.

image._sizes: bytes from the Hugging Face API tree listings on 2026-11-09

wan2.2-ti2v-5b.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B
wan2.2-ti2v-5b.license_source: model card of Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B (re-check before redistribution)
wan2.2-ti2v-5b.plain_en: Makes a short video clip (about 2 seconds at a time) from a description, or animates a picture you give it.
wan2.2-ti2v-5b.plain_es: Crea un clip corto de video (unos 2 segundos por vez) a partir de una descripción, o anima una imagen que le des.
wan2.2-ti2v-5b.limits_en: Short clips, no sound; minutes per clip on a strong graphics card, hours on a processor; faces and hands can warp.
wan2.2-ti2v-5b.limits_es: Clips cortos, sin sonido; minutos por clip con una buena placa de video, horas con procesador; caras y manos pueden deformarse.

video._sizes: bytes from the Hugging Face API tree listings on 2026-11-09; defaults from stable-diffusion.cpp docs/wan.md
